name: amicro-universal-frontend-style
title: Amicro Universal Frontend Style
job_to_be_done: Apply or port the Amicro-inspired visual language, scoped design tokens, component surfaces, and restrained micro-transitions to an existing frontend. Use for React, Next.js, Vue, Nuxt, Svelte, Astro, Tailwind, CSS Modules, CSS-in-JS, or vanilla HTML/CSS/JS when the user asks for Amicro styling, tactile motion, a style migration, or an implementation audit. Preserve product behavior, content, component APIs, accessibility, branding, and the target stack. Exclude backend work, generic brand identity design, install-only support, visual critique without implementation, and verbatim cloning of Amicro product content.

should_trigger: Apply Amicro-inspired cards, scoped tokens, and restrained micro-transitions to this React pricing page without changing its business logic.
把这个 Vue 页面改成 Amicro 风格，保留品牌色和组件 API，不要新增动效依赖。
Port the Amicro visual language into this Svelte dashboard and make every motion state safe for reduced motion.
Audit this frontend repository, then implement scoped Amicro tokens, surfaces, focus states, and touch-safe controls.
Use the existing Tailwind setup to add Amicro-style nested surfaces and tactile button feedback.
给这个原生 HTML 页面加 Amicro 微交互、明暗主题和 320px 响应式适配。
Create a reduced-motion-safe Amicro page transition using the motion library already installed in the app.
Migrate one representative component to the Amicro design grammar and verify it in the browser.
should_not_trigger: Explain what micro-interactions are without modifying any frontend.
Install the upstream Amicro package and do nothing else.
Design a new logo and brand identity for a company named Amicro.
Optimize this database query and backend API.
Copy the Amicro website, logo, screenshots, and product copy exactly.
Summarize the Amicro README in Chinese.
Review whether this page looks good, but do not implement changes or use a specific style.
Help me choose between React and Vue for a new backend-heavy application.
edge_cases: Show three examples of Amicro components I might use later, without changing my project.
Add one generic fade-in snippet to this element; I do not want a reusable style system.
Create a broad brand moodboard where Amicro is only one of many references.
Run an accessibility audit on this frontend without changing its visual language.

steps: Identify the target slice, framework, style entrypoint, theme model, existing motion library, checks, and contracts to preserve.
Read `references/design-language.md` and `references/migration-workflow.md`. Add motion or framework references only when needed.
Pilot the smallest useful layer: token roles, surfaces, geometry, focus, component states, then optional motion.
Run the target project's format, type, lint, test, and build commands, followed by:
Render relevant states at 320, 360, 768, and 1440px. Check focus, touch, exact accessible names, themes, reduced motion, clipping, overflow, RTL when relevant, and runtime errors.
Report changed files, preserved contracts, checks actually run, rendered states actually inspected, and unresolved caveats.
